title: M3.4 Qualified Release Set contradictory QA

finding.title: Forged PASS FactoryRun can be admitted after digest recomputation
finding.observed: A genuine semantic HOLD FactoryRun can have factoryEvidence.verdict, finalDecision and decision changed to PASS; after recomputing factoryEvidenceSha256, bundleSha256 and runId, reliability.verify_run accepts it and release_set.build_release_archive admits it.
finding.expected: Qualified Release Set admission must reject forged PASS decisions rather than trusting only internally self-consistent hashes.

promotionBoundary: PR #323 remains blocked. Any product repair creates a new product HEAD and invalidates this exact-head QA verdict.
